articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs and Buffalo Bills headline one of the biggest matchups of NFL Week 12 of the 2026 season . Josh Allen and the Bills host Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs at Highmark Stadium in a showdown with major implications for the AFC playoff race and the battle for the conference's top seed.

Buffalo enters the game as one of the NFL's elite teams with a 9-1 record , while Kansas City arrives at 8-2 looking to stay in contention for the AFC West title and improve its position in the playoff standings.

The matchup also marks another chapter in the rivalry between Josh Allen and Patrick Mahomes , two quarterbacks who have defined the AFC over the last several seasons and delivered some of the most memorable games in recent NFL history.

The Bills bring one of the league's most explosive offenses, led by Allen and weapons such as DJ Moore, Khalil Shakir, Keon Coleman, Dalton Kincaid and James Cook III . The Chiefs , meanwhile, rely on Mahomes' playmaking ability, the experience of Travis Kelce , and the speed of Rashee Rice, Xavier Worthy and Kenneth Walker III .

Beyond the quarterback battle, Thursday's showdown features a clash of strengths. Kansas City enters with the fewest points allowed in the AFC , while Buffalo has proven to be one of the most complete teams in the league on both sides of the ball.

The result could have a major impact on the AFC playoff picture . A Bills victory would strengthen their grip on the conference lead and home-field advantage, while a Chiefs win would put Kansas City back in the conversation for the top seed.

What time do the Chiefs play the Bills? Where can fans watch the NFL Week 12 matchup live? Get the kickoff time, TV channel, latest updates, prediction, and everything you need to know before Kansas City vs. Buffalo.

The rivalry that has defined the modern era of the American Football Conference (AFC) is heating up once again. In Week 12 of the 2026 NFL season , the Buffalo Bills host the Kansas City Chiefs at Highmark Stadium in a heavyweight showdown between two of the league's top contenders -- a matchup that could dramatically reshape the race for the AFC's No. 1 seed .

Thanksgiving showdown: two AFC powerhouses collide

Few games arrive with both teams playing at such a high level. Buffalo enters as the AFC leader with a 9-1 record , owning the best mark in the conference and the second-best record in the NFL, trailing only the San Francisco 49ers (9-1) in point differential.

The Bills have been dominant on both sides of the ball, scoring 313 points while allowing 208 , good for a +105 point differential that reflects their consistency throughout the season.

Kansas City , meanwhile, comes into the matchup at 8-2 , sitting second in the AFC West behind the Denver Broncos (8-2) due to tiebreakers and ranked sixth overall in the league standings.

The biggest strength of the Chiefs has been their defense. Kansas City has allowed just 163 points , the fewest in the AFC, and their +108 point differential is actually slightly better than Buffalo's.

In other words, Thursday's matchup features a clash between one of the NFL's most explosive offenses and the AFC's stingiest defense -- a true chess match at Highmark Stadium.

Josh Allen vs. Patrick Mahomes: another chapter in an NFL rivalry

This matchup hardly needs extra hype. Once again, the spotlight will belong to the two quarterbacks who have defined the AFC over the last decade: Josh Allen and Patrick Mahomes .

Allen, 30, leads the Bills' offense with his combination of arm strength, mobility and playmaking ability. He enters the game surrounded by a revamped group of weapons, including wide receivers DJ Moore, Khalil Shakir and Keon Coleman , while tight end Dalton Kincaid remains a key target in the middle of the field.

In the backfield, James Cook III has become a crucial piece of Buffalo's rushing attack, helping the Bills control the clock and keep pressure off Allen against a Kansas City defense that thrives on forcing mistakes.

On the other side, Mahomes continues to lead an experienced Chiefs offense built for big moments. Travis Kelce , now 37 years old, remains his most trusted target in critical situations, while Rashee Rice and speedster Xavier Worthy provide explosive options downfield.

At running back, Kenneth Walker III gives Kansas City another dimension and will be key in preventing the Chiefs from becoming too predictable against Buffalo's defense.

Where to watch Chiefs vs. Bills live and kickoff time

The Chiefs vs. Bills Week 12 matchup is scheduled for Thursday, November 26, 2026 , with kickoff set for 5:20 p.m. ET (4:20 p.m. CT / 2:20 p.m. PT) .

The game will be broadcast nationally in the United States on NBC .

The matchup will take place at Highmark Stadium in Buffalo , which has a capacity of 71,608 fans .

The stakes go far beyond a regular-season rivalry game.

For the Bills , a victory would improve their record to 10-1 and strengthen their path toward securing home-field advantage throughout the AFC playoffs .

For the Chiefs , a win in Buffalo would put them in position to match the Bills with only two losses and give them a valuable head-to-head tiebreaker that could become crucial when playoff seeding is decided in January.

Kansas City is also battling for control of the AFC West , where every result matters with the Chiefs and Broncos both sitting at 8-2 .

Chiefs vs. Bills prediction

This matchup has all the ingredients of a game decided by the smallest details.

Buffalo's home-field advantage , its 9-1 record , and its balance on offense and defense make the Bills a slight favorite. However, Kansas City's elite defense and Mahomes' ability to deliver in the biggest moments make the Chiefs impossible to count out.

Prediction: Bills win a close game , with the outcome likely coming down to the final possession.
